title: Verilay Diploma Credential v2
description: Credential asserting that the subject holds an educational qualification: which institution awarded it, what it is, at which ISCED level, and when — plus how it was verified: the grade on the education scale, the source, the date, the evidence method and the hash of the evidence document. Merklized: no iden3_serialization directive, every subject field is addressable through the merklization root.

institution.title: Institution
institution.description: Name of the awarding institution as it appears on the diploma, e.g. "Technical University of Munich". Institutions are not Verilay accounts and there is no institution registry, so this is a display string rather than a resolvable identifier; equality and set-membership queries only.

degree.title: Degree
degree.description: Human-readable title of the qualification, e.g. "Master of Science". For display and for a reader to see what was actually awarded. Query degreeLevel instead — free-text titles vary by country and institution and will not match reliably.

degreeLevel.title: Degree Level
degreeLevel.description: ISCED 2011 level of the qualification: 3 upper secondary (a school-leaving diploma), 5 short-cycle tertiary, 6 bachelor's or equivalent, 7 master's or equivalent, 8 doctoral or equivalent. This is the queryable form of "degree" — an integer, so "at least a bachelor's" is a range query the on-chain verifier can evaluate, which no free-text title could express. The full 0-8 range is allowed deliberately: a school-leaving diploma is a diploma, and the range cannot be widened later without a new schema version and reissuance.

fieldOfStudy.title: Field of Study
fieldOfStudy.description: Subject area of the qualification as awarded, e.g. "Computer Science". Optional — not every qualification names one. Free text, so equality and set-membership queries only, and a policy relying on it must enumerate the spellings it accepts.

awardedAt.title: Awarded At
awardedAt.description: Date the qualification was awarded, encoded as the integer YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20190715. Integer encoding makes "graduated after" a range query.

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: How strongly the source proved this education, as an ordinal integer on the education scale: CRYPTO=4, REGISTRY=3, ISSUER=2, APOSTILLE_ONLY=1, UNVERIFIABLE=0. Higher is stronger, so "at least" a grade is an on-chain range query (grade >= N), the same way degreeLevel works. UNVERIFIABLE (0) is part of the scale but no credential is ever issued at 0: a request that cannot be verified ends without a credential. The scale is frozen with this schema version; adding, removing or reordering a grade is a new schema version.

source.title: Source
source.description: Identifier of the verification source that produced the grade, e.g. "br.diploma_digital" — the issuer's source-adapter id, or a finer source name where one adapter covers several. Equality and set-membership queries only.

verifiedAt.title: Verified At
verifiedAt.description: Date the verification concluded, encoded as the integer YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20260923. Integer encoding makes "verified since" a range query.

documentHash.title: Document Hash
documentHash.description: SHA-256 of the evidence document's bytes exactly as submitted to the issuer, as 64 lowercase hex characters. Binds the credential to the document that was verified without disclosing it. Optional: absent when the source had no document to hash — never the empty string, which cannot be merklized. Equality queries only.

evidenceMethod.title: Evidence Method
evidenceMethod.description: How the evidence was checked, e.g. XADES_ICP_BRASIL_OFFLINE, PORTAL_CODE_RECHECK, OPERATOR_PORTAL_CHECK, EMPLOYER_ATTESTATION_SIGNED. Distinguishes an automated check from an operator-resolved one at the same grade. Equality and set-membership queries only.

institutionCode.title: Institution Code
institutionCode.description: Identifier of the awarding institution in the source's own registry, e.g. the e-MEC IES code for a Brazilian diploma, or the registry's institution id. Optional: only sources with an institution registry provide one. Meaningful only together with source; equality and set-membership queries only.

courseCode.title: Course Code
courseCode.description: Identifier of the course or programme in the source's own registry, e.g. the e-MEC course code. Optional: only sources with a course registry provide one. Meaningful only together with source; equality and set-membership queries only.

accreditationSnapshotAt.title: Accreditation Snapshot At
accreditationSnapshotAt.description: Date of the accreditation snapshot the institution and course were checked against, e.g. the e-MEC sync, encoded as the integer YYYYMMDD. Optional: present only when the source checks accreditation. Integer, so range queries.
